titleEn: Decision no. 141 on the establishment of the Working Group for the impact assessment of legal instruments of the Ministry of Planning

articles.en:
The Working Group for the assessment of the impact of legal instruments of the Ministry of Planning is hereby established to carry out assessments of the impact of legal instruments, with the following composition: [illegible address line]
[Legacy-font text: address and contact details of the Ministry of Planning]
1- H.E. Tuy Sinna, Secretary of State, President
2- H.E. Kong Romvon Lida, Under-Secretary of State, Vice-President
3- H.E. San Slav, Under-Secretary of State, Vice-President
4- Mr Van Sopheap, Deputy Director of the Cabinet, Permanent Member
5- Mr Nob Kanhnavuth, Deputy Director-General of the General Department of Planning, Member
6- Ms Da, Deputy Director-General of the General Department of General Affairs, Member
7- Mr Pun Sohai, Deputy Secretary-General of the General Secretariat for Population and Development, Member
8- Mr Chea Chanthola, Deputy Director-General of the National Institute of Statistics, Member
9- Mr Sem Simanit, Deputy Inspector-General of the General Inspectorate, Member
10- Mr Hueng Sophal, Deputy Director of the National School of Planning and Statistics, Member
11- Mr Tit Polin, Deputy Head of the Internal Audit Department, Member
12- Mr Kem Kimheng, Official of the Cabinet, Member.

This Working Group shall have the following roles and duties: - to prepare the action plan for implementing the monitoring and assessment of the impact of legal instruments relating to the planning sector; - to study and prepare the methodology for assessing the impact of legal instruments; - to prepare reports on the assessment of the impact of legal instruments for submission to the leadership of the Ministry of Planning for review and decision; - to prepare monthly, quarterly, semi-annual, nine-month and annual reports for the leadership of the Ministry of Planning; - to perform other duties as assigned by the Minister of Planning.

This Working Group shall have an Executive Team with the following composition:
1- Dr Duong Vuth, Acting Head of the Department of General Administration, President
2- Ms Lang Bolin, Acting Head of the Department of International Cooperation, Vice-President
3- Mr Men Khoeun, Deputy Head of the Department of General Administration, Member
4- Mr Khuon Sokunthea, Deputy Head of the Department of International Cooperation, Member
5- Mr Khun Kandy, Deputy Head of the Department of International Cooperation, Member
6- Mr Phit Chamrerin, Deputy Head of the Department of International Cooperation, Member
7- Ms Chey Mina, Deputy Head of the Department of General Administration, Member
8- Mr Kang Kimhab, Official of the Department of General Administration, Member
9- Mr Van Monika, Official of the Department of General Administration, Member.
The Department of General Administration of the General Department of General Affairs shall serve as the secretariat of this Executive Team in order to coordinate the work of the Working Group for the assessment of the impact of legal instruments of the Ministry of Planning.

- This Executive Team shall have the following duties: - to coordinate and organise all the work of the Working Group for the assessment of the impact of legal instruments; - to prepare plans for the operation of the Working Group for the assessment of the impact of legal instruments; - to draft reports on the assessment of the impact of legal instruments; - to prepare reports on the results of the work for the Working Group for the assessment of the impact of legal instruments; - to perform other duties as assigned by the President of the Working Group.

- The Working Group for the assessment of the impact of legal instruments and the Executive Team shall attend meetings upon the invitation of the President. Where the President is absent, or in necessary cases, the President may delegate authority to one of the Vice-Presidents to chair the meeting in his or her place.
- Any provisions contrary to this Decision shall be considered null and void.

- The Director of the Cabinet, the Director-General of the General Department of General Affairs, the heads of the relevant units and the persons referred to in Article 1 and Article 3 shall be responsible for implementing this Decision in accordance with their respective duties from the date of signature onwards; [date in the lunar calendar, Buddhist Era 2568]; Phnom Penh, [day illegible] [month illegible] 2024.
Recipients: [illegible], Bin Trochai - Office of the Council of Ministers - Ministry of Economy and Finance - Ministry of Civil Service - Cabinet of the Minister of Planning - as per Article 7 - archives
